  WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND CAST(SUBSTRING(ym.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2012, 2013)
  GROUP BY c.segment, CAST(SUBSTRING(ym.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
pivot_data AS (
  SELECT 
    segment,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN total_consumption END) AS consumption_2012,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN total_consumption END) AS consumption_2013
  FROM yearly_consumption
  GROUP BY segment
),
changes AS (
  SELECT 
    segment,
    ((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / NULLIF(consumption_2013, 0)) * 100 AS percentage_change
  FROM pivot_data
  WHERE consumption_2012 IS NOT NULL AND consumption_2013 IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    segment,
    percentage_change,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percentage_change DESC) AS rank_desc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percentage_change ASC) AS rank_asc
  FROM changes
)
SELECT 
  segment,
  percentage_change
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_desc = 1 OR rank_asc = 1
ORDER BY percentage_change DESC;"}

{"sql": "WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE isstoryspotlight = 1 AND istextless = 0) as matching,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE isstoryspotlight = 1) as total_spotlight
  FROM cards
)
SELECT 
  100.0 * stats.matching / NULLIF(stats.total_spotlight, 0) AS percentage,
  cards.id
FROM cards
CROSS JOIN stats
WHERE cards.isstoryspotlight = 1 AND cards.istextless = 0
ORDER BY cards.id"}

{"sql": "WITH bond_counts AS (

  m.label

{"sql": "WITH locally_funded AS (
  SELECT 
    frpm.cdscode,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" - frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_diff

),
avg_enrollment AS (
  SELECT AVG(enrollment_diff) AS avg_diff FROM locally_funded
)

{"sql": "WITH female_clients AS (
  SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.birth_date,
    d.a11
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
oldest_birth AS (
  SELECT MIN(fc.birth_date) as oldest_date
  FROM female_clients fc
),
oldest_females AS (
  SELECT 
    fc.client_id,
    fc.a11
  FROM female_clients fc
  CROSS JOIN oldest_birth ob
  WHERE fc.birth_date = ob.oldest_date
),
lowest_salary_of_oldest AS (
  SELECT MIN(of.a11) as min_a11
  FROM oldest_females of
),
target_clients AS (
  SELECT of.client_id
  FROM oldest_females of
  CROSS JOIN lowest_salary_of_oldest lso
  WHERE of.a11 = lso.min_a11
),
salary_gap_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(fc.a11) - MIN(fc.a11) as gap
  FROM female_clients fc
)
SELECT 
  acc.account_id,
  sgc.gap
FROM target_clients tc
JOIN disp ON tc.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
CROSS JOIN salary_gap_calc sgc"}

{"sql": "WITH target_loan AS (
  SELECT loan.account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE loan.date = '1993-07-05'
  ORDER BY loan.loan_id
  LIMIT 1
),
target_account AS (
  SELECT account.account_id
  FROM account
  WHERE account.account_id IN (SELECT target_loan.account_id FROM target_loan)
),
balance_at_start AS (
  SELECT trans.balance
  FROM target_account
  JOIN trans ON target_account.account_id = trans.account_id
  WHERE trans.date <= '1993-03-22'
  ORDER BY trans.date DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
balance_at_end AS (
  SELECT trans.balance
  FROM target_account
  JOIN trans ON target_account.account_id = trans.account_id
  WHERE trans.date <= '1998-12-27'
  ORDER BY trans.date DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  ((balance_at_end.balance - balance_at_start.balance) / NULLIF(balance_at_start.balance, 0)) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM balance_at_end
CROSS JOIN balance_at_start"}
